[TITLE]
Girdle of Grace

[LYRICS]

Verse 1:  
O Lord, You spoke to me, a call to wear,  
A linen girdle, pure, a symbol to bear.  
In the depths of obedience, I found my place,  
Yet I hid it by Euphrates, lost in Your grace.  

Chorus:  
As the girdle clings to the waist,  
So You cling to us, in love and in grace.  
But we wander far, in pride we fall,  
O Lord, hear our cry, we need Your call.  

Verse 2:  
Days turned to shadows, the word came again,  
“Rise up, take the girdle, for it’s marred by sin.”  
I dug in the river where I’d laid it low,  
Profitable for nothing, like hearts turned to stone.  

Chorus:  
As the girdle clings to the waist,  
So You cling to us, in love and in grace.  
But we wander far, in pride we fall,  
O Lord, hear our cry, we need Your call.  

Bridge:  
We’ve chased after gods, in darkness we roam,  
But Your voice calls us back, to turn and come home.  
Humble our hearts, let us bow down in fear,  
Before the darkness, let Your light draw near.  

Verse 3:  
Hear, O Jerusalem, the cry of the Lord,  
Your beauty is fading, your heart’s grown bored.  
Yet there’s hope in the sorrow, in the tears that we shed,  
For You long to cleanse us, to rise from the dead.  

Chorus:  
As the girdle clings to the waist,  
So You cling to us, in love and in grace.  
But we wander far, in pride we fall,  
O Lord, hear our cry, we need Your call.  

Outro:  
Lift up our eyes, let us see the way,  
For You are the truth, our light, our stay.  
In the depths of our hearts, may we ever find,  
A girdle of grace, forever entwined.

Cast out by kin, yet chosen by grace,  
In the shadows of doubt, he found his place.  

[Verse 2]  
The elders came pleading, in their time of need,  
"Come lead us to battle, for we trust in your creed."  
He raised his voice, with a heart full of pain,  
"Did you not cast me out? Why are you here again?"  

[Chorus]

With courage unbroken, we’ll follow the light.  
O Lord, hear our vow, as we rise from the dust,  
In battles before us, we place all our trust.  

[Verse 3]  
He sent forth his message, the king of Ammon,  
"Why wage war against us? Our land was not won."

26.14:
[TITLE]

[LYRICS]

Verse 1:  
In the silence, we gather here,  
Elders kneel, hearts full of fear.  
Idols set, hearts turned away,  
Lord, we cry, “Please lead us today.”  
You’ve shown us our broken ways,  
Yet still, we seek Your face.  

Chorus:  
Return to You, O heart of stone,  
Break the chains, Lord, make us whole.  
In repentance, we turn our eyes,  
From the shadows, to the skies.  
You are our God, we are Your own,  
In Your presence, we are home.   

Verse 2:  
You’ve warned us of the coming strife,  
Famine, pestilence, a call to life.  
Noah, Daniel, and Job stood strong,  
Yet, Lord, we’ve wandered far too long.  
With every idol that we cling,  
We miss the hope Your mercy brings.  

Chorus:  
Return to You, O heart of stone,  
Break the chains, Lord, make us whole.  
In repentance, we turn our eyes,  
From the shadows, to the skies.  
You are our God, we are Your own,  
In Your presence, we are home.  

Bridge:  
So let the remnant rise and stand,  
A faithful heart, a holy band.  
Comfort us, O Lord, we plead,  
In Your grace, we find our need.  
No more wandering, no more fear,  
In Your love, we draw near.  

Chorus:  
Return to You, O heart of stone,
